Project Name: Consolidated Ready Mix Case No.: UP-2017-04, MUP-2017-18
Location: 162 N. Aspan Ave., Azusa, California
APN: 8615-018-005
The City of Azusa received a request for the approval of a Use Permit (UP-2017-04) for the hours of operation and Minor Use Permit (MUP_2017-18) for a dry batch concrete plant located at 162 North Aspan Avenue, Azusa, California.
The proposed project would operate dry batch concrete plant which mixes sand, rock, and concrete onsite. The dry material is loaded into a cement transport truck, then the water is added. As the truck drives to the delivery site, the material is mixed during the transport. The proposed project will have nine employees working in one shift seven days a week. The proposed hours of operation are 5:30 am- 4:30 pm (Monday through Friday), 5:30 am – 1:00 pm (Saturday), and 7:00 am – 10:00 am (Sunday).
The proposed project includes a request for the following entitlements:
Use Permit – for the extended hours
Minor Use Permit – for the concrete dry mixing operation.
